_: Which Unicode scripts each spoken language is written in, first its own (primary) script. A script only one language uses (kana, Hangul) decides a run's language; a shared one (Han, Latin) goes by its neighbours and the message's language, else to the language whose primary script it is. Read by lang-runs.ts.
_borrowed: Scripts other languages' text borrows words in (an acronym, a name, a short term): a run in one of these, inside text whose language is not written in it, keeps the surrounding language unless it has at least this many words.
_glueMax: A shared-script run (Han) glued to a run another language decides (kana) joins that language only when it is at most this many characters long, so the Chinese around a Japanese word stays Chinese. Longer ones go by the text's language.
